plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instructions replayed a fragile CSS selector (`#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button`) to open the 'Developers' dropdown menu. On the current site layout, `div:nth-of-type(2)` now points to the 'Solutions' menu item, leading the step to open 'Solutions' and navigate to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/'. Clearing the stale page.ai cache will allow page.ai to dynamically resolve the correct 'Developers' menu on retry.
observedIndicators: The cached page.ai step used `#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button`, which targeted and clicked the 'Solutions' menu button instead of 'Developers'.
The test subsequently navigated to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/'.
The assertion `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` failed because the cache steered the browser to the wrong page.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry test execution
remediationSteps.details: Clear the page.ai deterministic cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run the test autonomously so page.ai re-locates the 'Developers' and 'Documentation' links.

plan.notes: Clearing the cached page.ai instructions and re-running the test autonomously will resolve the misdirected navigation.
